description: This file defines the interface for a 'Library' class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It manages dynamic library loading, reference counting, and function retrieval, with platform-specific handle management for Linux and Windows.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class that encapsulates dynamic library loading, reference counting, and symbol resolution.

methods.name: Library
methods.description: Default constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the library object with a function pointer within the library.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructor that loads a library from the specified filename.

methods.name: Library(Library&& move)
methods.description: Move constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: Library(const Library& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: Library& operator=(const Library& RHS)
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying library instances.

methods.name: IsLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the library is currently loaded.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the last error message related to library operations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the loaded library.

methods.name: LoadFunction
methods.description: Loads a function from the library by name.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the library handle.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads the library if no longer used.
